# ferriskey_email_template_variables (Data Source)

Lists the variables that can be referenced in an email template of a given type. The list is global and not realm-scoped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ferriskey_email_template_variables" "reset" {
  email_type = "reset_password"
}

output "reset_variables" {
  value = [for v in data.ferriskey_email_template_variables.reset.variables : v.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_type` (String) Email type: `reset_password`, `magic_link` or `email_verification`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equal to `email_type`.
- `variables` (Attributes List) Available template variables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the variable.
- `name` (String) Variable name, e.g. `user.first_name`.
